Do you enjoy bringing out the best in people, keeping production on track and tackling the occasional curveball? Then you might be the Production Manager we're looking for.

At Aasted, we are looking for a Production Manager to lead our Combined Lines Solutions production department. You will take responsibility for a team of more than 40 employees and play an important role in creating a workplace where people thrive, work together and deliver high-quality solutions to customers around the world.

**About The Role

**As our new Production Manager, you will be responsible for the daily operations, performance and development of the Combined Lines Solutions production department.

Your most important responsibility will be leading and developing your team. Through clear communication, involvement and hands-on leadership, you will create the structure and motivation needed for employees to succeed.

You will report to the Head of Value Stream and work closely with 4 other competent Production Managers to ensure efficient production and timely deliveries.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead, motivate and develop a team of more than 40 production employees, with a strong focus on wellbeing, collaboration and performance.

• Ensure efficient daily production operations, including resource allocation, capacity planning and delivery performance.

• Work closely with the department's Planner to coordinate production schedules, priorities and resources.

• Monitor production performance, quality, costs and relevant KPIs, and take action when improvements are needed.

• Drive continuous improvements through structured processes, Lean principles and 5S initiatives.

• Ensure a safe working environment and compliance with quality, safety and environmental standards.

• Manage the department's production budget and contribute to efficient use of resources.

• Strengthen collaboration across production departments and other functions to ensure a smooth production flow.

**About You

**We're looking for someone who knows their way around a production floor, enjoys working with people and understands that great results don't happen on their own.

You enjoy being close to the daily operations, supporting your employees and creating an environment where everyone understands their responsibilities and works towards common goals. You are comfortable making decisions, setting priorities and maintaining an overview, even when plans change.

You bring structure to a busy production environment and have the confidence to challenge existing ways of working when improvements are needed.

We imagine that you:

• Have several years of management experience from a technical or industrial production environment.

• You may have a technical education or have learned your way through years of hands-on experience. What matters most is that you know production and how to lead people.

• Have a proven ability to lead, motivate and develop production teams.

• Understand production planning, capacity management and operational performance.

• Have experience with continuous improvement, preferably Lean and 5S.

• Are comfortable working with production data, KPIs and ERP systems.

• Communicate clearly and build strong working relationships across different teams and departments.

Above all, you are a leader who takes an interest in people, leads by example and takes pride in seeing your team succeed.

**About Us

**You will become part of a well-established international company with a strong Danish heritage, where relationships are highly valued. In 2026, Aasted became part of the Italian Piovan Group, opening new perspectives and opportunities as part of a larger international group in the years to come.

At Aasted, our culture is characterized by motivated employees who take pride in their work, creating a strong sense of teamwork and commitment. We value open, honest and direct communication and believe in treating people with respect and integrity in everything we do.

We continuously strive to create an inclusive workplace with equal opportunities for development for all employees. We offer an attractive parental leave scheme, social events and a nice canteen operated by Meyers Kantine.

At Aasted, we prioritize a healthy working environment and are therefore a smoke-free workplace. This means that smoking is not permitted during working hours or anywhere on company premises.

**We look forward to hearing from you

**We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your CV and application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions or would simply like to learn more about the position, please feel free to contact Head of Value Stream, Combined Lines Solutions, Maria Osk Sigurdardottir, at mao@aasted.eu.

At Aasted, we strive to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We therefore encourage everyone to apply, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or political and cultural background.

You can read more about us and what we do here: AASTED | Welcome to our world

**_Aasted – a Danish pioneer

_**_Aasted has been a market leader in equipment and production lines for chocolate manufacturing worldwide for more than 100 years. Our customer portfolio includes both smaller local businesses and some of the world's largest global FMCG companies.

__We are on a continuous journey driven by curiosity, which has enabled us to rethink what was previously considered possible in chocolate production. We challenge the impossible and make it possible. We continuously introduce a wide range of groundbreaking and patented solutions for our customers, helping each of them achieve their unique vision.

_At Aasted, we are more than 550 people who, through passion, experience and expertise, challenge the status quo.

_atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

__With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

__Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

__We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

__By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

_**People Transformation & Projects Lead - Help us connect strategy, people and execution

**At atNorth, growth creates a lot of opportunities. It also creates complexity.

As we continue to expand across markets, functions and countries, we need someone who can help connect the dots across the organization and turn ideas into action (and effective processes ;-) ).

We are looking for a People Transformation & Projects Lead to join our People Technology, Analytics & Process Excellence team. This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys working across organizational boundaries, solving complex challenges, manage stakeholders and driving meaningful change.

This is not a traditional P&C/HR role.

Instead, you will work at the intersection of People & Culture and other business functions where you will act as a bridge between teams, helping different stakeholders align around common goals and ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into practical solutions and measurable results.

**About The Role

**Success at atNorth requires more than great ideas. It requires collaboration, alignment and execution.

As People Transformation & Projects Lead, you will help connect business needs, people, processes and technology to create solutions that work in practice.

Some days you may be leading a cross-functional project involving Operations, IT and People & Culture. Other days you may be helping leaders navigate organizational challenges, improve ways of working or implement new initiatives.

Your role is to create momentum, remove obstacles and ensure that the right people are working together towards shared outcomes.

You will be part of the People Technology, Analytics & Projects team, working closely with specialists in HR technology, analytics, AI, process development and digital transformation

**Key responsibilities -> What will you do?

****_Drive transformation initiatives

_**

• Lead projects and initiatives from identified needs and business challenges through solution design, implementation and follow-up.

• Transform ideas into tangible actions and ensure delivery of measurable outcomes.

• Drive transformation and change initiatives, ensuring successful adoption of new ways of working, processes and organizational practices.

**_Connect functions and build bridges

_**

• Act as a connector across other areas as example; Operations, IT, Strategy, Finance and People & Culture.

• Bring together different perspectives, facilitate collaboration and ensure solutions work across organizational boundaries.

• Help break down silos and create stronger alignment between teams, priorities and ways of working.

**_Partner with the P&C Leadership Team

_**

• Work closely with the P&C Leadership Team to identify priorities, solve complex organizational challenges and accelerate execution of key initiatives.

• Provide structure, analysis and coordination to support decision-making and help ensure alignment between strategic objectives and operational delivery.

• Act as a sparring partner on organizational effectiveness, ways of working and business improvement opportunities.

**_Turn strategy into execution

_**

• Translate strategic priorities into practical plans and actions.

• Support leaders and stakeholders in moving from discussions and decisions to implementation and results.

**_Improve how we work & drive progress and accountability

_**

• Coordinate activities, stakeholders, timelines and dependencies across multiple initiatives.

• Support process improvements, organizational effectiveness and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Contribute to scalable ways of working that support atNorth's continued growth.

• Lead Process Excellence initiatives within People & Culture, driving the simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement of processes and ways of working to enhance efficiency, consistency, employee experience, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Your profile:

**You enjoy working where functions, ideas and challenges intersect and you rolemodel collaboration, accountability and a continuous improvement mindset.

You are naturally curious and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You quickly build relationships, understand different perspectives and help people find common ground.

You are equally comfortable discussing strategic priorities with senior leaders as rolling up your sleeves and contributing hands-on when needed.

Most importantly, you are someone who enjoys connecting people, teams and initiatives to achieve outcomes that no single function could deliver alone.

You communicate fluent in written and spoken in at least english and other nordic languages is meriting.

You have at least 5 years of experience from the majority areas listed below:

• Transformation and change management

• Project or program management

• Management consulting

• Business improvement initiatives

• Organizational development

• HR, Operations, Technology or Strategy functions

**About the atNorth Culture

**_We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

__We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

__We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

__At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.

_**Application

**Please submitt your application no later than 28:th October, please note - ongoing selection reviews will be conducted and the position might be closed before end date.

_Also - please note - atNorth will at this point not have the possibility to support any work permits or visas for this role.

Planetary is looking for a Managing Director (Fondsdirektør) to lead Planetary A/S and the continued development of its two investment funds: Planetary Impact Ventures and Planetary Soil Fund.

At Planetary, we invest in companies and farmland aligned with our guiding principles. We invest in companies with a focus on long-term business models within planetary boundaries, and in degraded farmland and partners who are committed to soil regeneration. Our commitment is manifested in our evergreen structure. Our focus is biodiversity, agriculture and food, and we aim to provide a fair financial return. We want to inspire and contribute to a restructuring of our economic systems, a redefinition of what value is, and increase our understanding and reconnection with nature and life on the planet.

At Planetary, our work does not stop with investments. Our theory of change is focusing on a systemic and broad approach. We work to nourish and contribute to the community around us. We believe that value alignment between investors, us as intermediaries, and our portfolio companies is essential to the success of our shared mission. These principles are instrumental to the way we work – and who we are.

The role

As Managing Director, you will have the overall responsibility for Planetary A/S, ensuring strong governance and compliance, performance and development of the funds. You will report to the Board, and work closely with all the people working at Planetary.

Your work will be grounded in a deep commitment to systems change and a transition towards organic-regenerative food and agriculture.

Key responsibilities

Planetary and organisational leadership

·      Lead and develop Planetary’s organisation and its two funds in close collaboration with the Board, the active Partners, the Investment Committees and Fund Directors.

·      Take responsibility for Planetary’s financial management, budgets and allocation of resources.

·      Lead fundraising and relationships with LPs and key stakeholders.

·      Take responsibility for company-level reporting and compliance in coordination with our fund directors.

·      Ensure strong governance, transparent Board reporting and effective follow-up on decisions.

·      Ensure that Planetary’s impact objectives are integrated into investment strategy, portfolio management and decision-making across both funds.

·      Lead according to the culture rooted in Planetary’s values, combining intellectual curiosity, courage and humility with collaboration, care for people and planet, sound commercial judgment and high standards.

Together with the Fund Directors

·      Support the investment teams, ensuring sound investment practices, high-quality investment decisions and effective collaboration with the Investment Committees and the Board.

·      Support founders and management teams of the companies where Planetary can contribute experience, perspective and network.

·      Maintain oversight of portfolio performance, risks, opportunities and capital requirements.

·      Take board roles in portfolio companies.

You have:

·      Experience with investing.

·      Proven track record in operational leadership and business development.

·      Strong analytical and financial management skills.

·      Experience in people leadership and organisational development.

·      Good communication, interpersonal skills and stakeholder management abilities.

·      A deeply rooted commitment to contributing to a healthier planet.

You are likely to have:

·      Several years’ experience from venture capital, impact investment, private equity or another relevant investment environment.

·      A solid understanding of fund economics, fund raising, portfolio performance and investments.

·      An understanding of impact management and the integration of financial and impact objectives.

Experience within food and organic-regenerative agriculture is an advantage, but not a prerequisite. Commitment to transforming the food system towards a more regenerative and resilient future is essential.

The right candidate

You are an experienced leader with a strong understanding of investments and of how capital can contribute to systemic change.

You combine sound judgement and the ability to create momentum with curiosity, collaboration and humility. You enjoy working in a small organisation where people remain close to the work and are motivated by long-term development.

__________________________________________________________________________

Location

Our office is at an organic farm in Humlebæk.

Timeline and application

Please apply before November 6th, 2026. Applications should be sent to Annette Hartvig Bohé at ahb@planetary.dk . Applications will be evaluated on an ongoing basis.

Questions

If you have questions about the job, feel free to reach out to Chair Jacob Jelsing, jj@planetary.dk, or Director Annette Hartvig Bohé, ahb@planetary.dk

Our guiding principles

Stay humble: Seeking to understand and improve the conditions for life on the planet is a task of infinite complexity. Grounded by nature, we stay humble and sincere in everything we do.

Learn with nature: Inspiration in nature and its biological processes will guide our investments. We shall adapt ourselves to nature, rather than forcing nature to comply with us.

Perceive wealth holistically: True wealth is much more than money in the bank. We perceive wealth as well-being and harmony between humans, nature and the economy.

Trust patient capital: Real value takes time to manifest. We support long-term business models and real value creation over quick profit maximisation.

Build strong communities: Strong communities build resilience and awareness. We strive to create movement and stronger connections within the networks we grow with.

Advocate for change: Real change depends on systemic change. We dedicate ourselves to create real, tangible change and assume leadership towards a new paradigm.

**Finance Business Partner, VELUX A/S - Østbirk

****Do you enjoy turning data into meaningful insights and working closely with people to influence decisions and drive performance? With a passion for business partnering and a strong analytical mindset, you could be our next Finance Business Partner in Østbirk.

****Meet your future team

**As part of our Global Finance team, you will join a group of dedicated and experienced colleagues supporting our production sites in Østbirk and Brædstrup. Together, we work to bring financial insights to life and enable informed business decisions that create value across the organisation.

In this role, you will work closely with operational leaders, managers, and finance stakeholders, building trusted relationships and gaining a deep understanding of our manufacturing business. We value collaboration, knowledge sharing, openness, and continuous learning, creating an environment where everyone can contribute and develop their skills.

**What We Offer

**As Finance Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting business performance and helping operational teams make data-driven decisions. You will have the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment where your expertise and insights contribute directly to business success.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Partner with managers and operational teams to provide financial insights and decision support.

• Monitor and analyse efficiency, production performance, material consumption, budgets, and key operational KPIs.

• Prepare financial analyses, business cases, and presentations to support strategic and operational decision-making.

• Support budgeting, forecasting, and monthly reporting processes.

• Contribute to standard costing and product costing activities within a manufacturing environment.

• Develop and enhance reports and dashboards using Excel and Power BI.

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, efficiencies, and value creation.

• Communicate financial information clearly and effectively to stakeholders across different functions and levels.

**What You Will Bring

**We are looking for a collaborative and curious finance professional who enjoys combining analytical thinking with strong business understanding. Whether your background is in Finance Business Partnering, Controlling, Financial Analysis, or a related field, you are motivated by creating value through insights and strong stakeholder relationships.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.

• Have strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into meaningful business insights.

• Build positive and productive relationships with stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• Have advanced Excel capabilities and an interest in reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI.

• Communicate fluently in both Danish and English.

• Work in a structured and organised manner while remaining flexible and solution-oriented.

• Thrive in a collaborative environment where teamwork and knowledge sharing are highly valued.

• Bring experience with SAP, standard costing, or product costing, although this is considered an advantage rather than a requirement.

If you do not meet every requirement but believe your experience and potential make you a strong candidate, we encourage you to apply. We recognise that diverse experiences and perspectives strengthen our teams and contribute to better outcomes.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof to transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees, and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape patient access across the Nordics by turning science into approved, available medicines? Do you thrive in complexity, navigating multiple indications and evolving legislation to find clear paths to approval? _Then this could be your next step with us at AstraZeneca!

_Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. This is an area where you are free to grow - you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways of working and exercise your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

**Introduction To Role

**In this Denmark-based role covering all Nordic countries, you will drive timely management of regulatory submissions and approvals, successful launches, and seamless lifecycle management to facilitate earlier access and safer use of our medicines. You will act as the regulatory affairs voice within brand and franchise teams, partnering closely with Market Access, Medical, Logistics, and others to connect regulatory strategy to real-world outcomes for patients and the business.

You will collaborate with European and global regulatory colleagues to influence plans with local insights, while being empowered to work independently and make decisions at pace to align science, policy, and patient need.

**Accountabilities

**

• Regulatory Strategy and Execution: Lead regulatory activities across launched products and pipeline assets to secure rapid, high-quality approvals and timely patient access.

• Intelligence and Foresight: Monitor changes in legislation and competitive activity to turn insights into advice, risk mitigation, and opportunities that shape plans and timelines.

• Authority Engagement: Build and maintain productive relationships with national health authorities; manage communications on pending issues and evolving requirements to de-risk regulatory approvals.

• Global Collaboration: Keep European and global regulatory teams current on local requirements and external dynamics; influence global strategies with Nordic perspectives.

• Compliance and Quality: Ensure labelling and compendial texts meet external requirements and AstraZeneca policies.

• Team Contribution: Drive ways-of-working improvements, contribute to department development, and share best practices that raise team effectiveness.

**Essential Skills/Experience

**

• Master's degree in Pharmacy or equivalent.

• Demonstrated experience with regulatory work.

• Experience from pharmaceutical development or manufacturing.

• Experience from working with health authorities.

• Excellent knowledge of English and at least one of the Nordic languages.

• Good knowledge of relevant legislation requirements and procedures.

• Solid business acumen and a good regulatory affairs toolbox to apply.

• Good at influencing and building relationships with senior and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Ability to plan, communicate and drive processes and projects all the way to the finish line.

**I&D

**We are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration. Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives - and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

**Why AstraZeneca?

**When we at AstraZeneca see every opportunity, no matter how small, as the beginning of something big. We are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration. Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives and are made to feel valued, energised and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

We strive to unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

**So, what is next?

**Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Great, because we cannot wait to hear from you!

Welcome with your application, in English, **latest by the 4th of November 2026!

**_Applications will be reviewed continuously throughout the application period.

We have an exciting opportunity for a seasoned Logistics Procurement Category Manager to join the Group Procurement function at Royal Unibrew.

Are you a passionate procurement and supply chain professional with expertise in Logistics and a demonstrated track record of positively influencing across internal and external ecosystems to unlock end to end value and efficiencies to fuel sustainable growth?

As Group Category Manager – Logistics, you will report to the CPO and lead the development and execution of the Group Logistics procurement strategy across road freight including line-haul and last mile distribution, ocean freight, warehousing and related logistics services including pallets. You will combine strategic category leadership with hands-on execution, working closely with local market organisations,

The role will be based at our HQ in Faxe, Denmark.

**Main Responsibilities

**Strategy Development:

• Define and execute a multi-year procurement category strategy for Logistics that balances local execution with strategic priorities to support the group’s overarching goals.

• Leverage a strong external radar and category expertise to identify, evaluate and act on emerging opportunities and risks, i.e. external supplier landscape, commodities, industry best practices, digitalisation and automation and EU legislative environment.

**Category And Supplier Relationship Management

**

• Optimise category management processes, elevate sourcing and contract management processes, and build best practices with the market teams and stakeholders. Increase utilisation of eSourcing and development of digital tools to support cost modelling, benchmarking, and contract management.

• Develop supplier collaboration platforms with key suppliers across the group to unlock operational efficiencies, process enhancements, digital innovation, and to accelerate sustainability and circularity initiatives.

**Value Delivery, Efficiency And Business Partnering

**

• Deliver cost savings, supply chain efficiencies and carbon reduction targets. Establish ways of working with stakeholders to measure relevant KPIs, track initiatives, manage risk and deliver multiyear productivity plans.

• Ensure early engagement and alignment with relevant stakeholders on business strategy to maintain a fit for purpose and efficient logistics network driving optimal cost to serve to fuel sustainable business growth.

• Provide category leadership and inputs into on strategic projects, integration, and network optimisation.

• Streamline processes and drive digitalisation agenda.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Bachelor’s degree. Professional CIPS qualification or similar will be considered.

• Min. 8 years of relevant procurement experience in logistics categories in an international or matrixed organisation. Nordics and CPG industry experience is a plus.

• Comprehensive knowledge of procurement processes, ERP systems, procurement tools and network modelling, including a strong data analytics skillset and commodity management experience.

• Excellent communication, gravitas and influencing skills to build relationships with senior stakeholders internally and externally.

• Team player with a service-oriented mindset but is also not afraid to challenge the status quo or be the critical friend when required.

• Project and change management - track record for initiating and embedding change.

• Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands on execution.

• Energised by challenges, white spaces, and complexity.

• Enthusiastic, solution-oriented approach.

• Passion for developing and coaching teams.

**What Success Looks Like

**Success in this role means creating a Logistics procurement organisation that is recognised as a strategic business partner, delivering measurable value beyond price reduction.

The successful candidate will establish strong Group category governance while enabling local ownership, build strategic supplier partnerships, increase data and digital maturity, strengthen resilience and sustainability, and continuously identify opportunities to improve the total cost, service and efficiency of Royal Unibrew's logistics network.

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

Royal Unibrew produces, markets, sells, and distributes quality beverages. We are a consortium of more than 35 breweries and beverage producers from across Denmark, known especially for our traditional, locally-rooted brands such as Faxe Kondi, Egekilde, Royal Beer, Ceres, and Odense Pilsner, as well as partner brands like Pepsi MAX and Heineken.

Today, we are the second-largest beverage company in Denmark. Our journey began in 1856, and we still maintain a strong commercial focus, a clear growth strategy, and an ambitious sustainability strategy - both domestically and internationally.

You'll have over 1500 colleagues in Denmark and more than 2700 colleagues outside the country, including in Finland, Italy, France, Norway, Canada, the Netherlands, and the Baltic countries.

With us, you'll be part of challenging the boundaries of sustainable production and distribution. You'll help ensure a diverse range of beverages that bring people together - on the dance floor, during the third half, or over a meal - all while contributing to strengthening Danish sports, music, and community life.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager, EndoIntelligence Solutions, Global R&D
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Project Manager with a background in medical device development? Do you enjoy leading complex development projects and coordinating work across internal teams and external development partners? Then you may be the Project Manager we are looking for in EndoIntelligence Solutions within Global R&D.

In this role, you will lead a strategically important development project and work closely with a global and cross-functional team to ensure successful project execution from planning through delivery.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Project Manager, you will:

• Lead a cross-functional development project through all phases of the product development process.

• Drive project planning, execution, follow-up, and reporting of scope, timeline, budget, risks, and key decisions.

• Coordinate activities across engineering disciplines and key stakeholders.

• Manage and maintain strong collaboration with external development partners and suppliers.

• Facilitate project governance activities, including Steering Committee reviews and decision-making forums.

• Ensure project documentation and deliverables are completed in accordance with Ambu's quality system and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Create transparency, alignment, and engagement across the project team and stakeholder landscape.

• Support the continuous improvement of project management practices and lessons learned.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the perfect candidate cannot be defined on paper. However, you are likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Hold a technical degree within engineering or a related field.

• Have experience leading the development of complex medical device hardware, including electronics, mechanics, embedded systems, and integration across disciplines.

• Have worked closely with external development partners and suppliers and understand how to manage outsourced development activities, technical deliverables, timelines, and risks.

• Have experience working with internal and external development teams across different regions, including Asian and European countries, and bring the cultural awareness needed to adapt ways of working and build effective collaboration across cultures.

• Are comfortable navigating a complex stakeholder environment and driving alignment across functions.

• Bring a structured and proactive approach to project execution and risk management.

• Have strong communication and leadership skills and enjoy working with international teams.

• Are fluent in written and spoken English.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**At Ambu, you will become part of an international organization with ambitious growth plans and a strong innovation agenda. We work in cross-functional teams and value collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to contribute to innovative healthcare solutions while developing your professional and personal capabilities in a dynamic environment.

Apply directly through our job portal. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**Ready to shape the marketing experience for one of the most exciting categories in Nordic e-commerce?

We are looking for a Marketing Manager for a maternity cover of approximately 13 months to drive the customer-facing journey and category performance across our Kids department. From everyday essentials to seasonal collections, footwear and accessories, you will bring the category to life through engaging campaigns, inspiring content and a seamless shopping experience across our channels.

This is your chance to join a passionate, fast-paced team where creativity meets commercial strategy, and where your work makes a real impact on how customers discover and shop Kids at Boozt.

**What You Will Do

**As our Marketing Manager for the kids category, you will play a key role in planning and executing marketing activities across onsite, CRM and campaign touchpoints, ensuring that the category stays relevant, engaging and commercially strong.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Develop and execute quarterly and yearly Kids marketing plans, aligned with commercial priorities and seasonal initiatives.

• 
Own the Kids front page and key landing pages, ensuring a strong and engaging digital shopping experience.

• 
Monitor traffic, engagement and category KPIs, using performance insights to evaluate results and optimize activities.

• 
Coordinate with Buying & Merchandising (B&M) on trading plans, product launches and brand exposure.

• 
Collaborate with CRM to develop engaging, high-performing email campaigns that support category priorities.

• 
Brief and coordinate visuals with our Content and Art teams for campaigns and seasonal initiatives, ensuring a consistent experience across onsite, landing pages and newsletters.

**YOUR PROFILE

**We are looking for someone who combines a creative mindset with a strong commercial understanding and knows how to turn customer insights and category trends into engaging marketing activities.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• 
At least 3 years of e-commerce marketing experience, preferably within fashion, kidswear or retail

• 
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities and deadlines

•

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is an advanced systems and industrialization company developing integrated technology platforms for demanding aerospace, security, and mission-critical applications. Its mission is to transform operationally validated technologies into scalable, ready-to-deploy systems by combining advanced engineering, industrial partnerships, and strong governance.

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development. The site will build core capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, industrialization, and deployment of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be an advanced aerospace signal-intelligence product platform covering RF and system architecture, antenna-system design, RF and microwave hardware, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for qualification, production, and operational deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and international deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s mechanical design capability for antenna and RF systems. The role is intended for an experienced mechanical engineer with prior hands-on experience developing the mechanical implementation of antenna, RF, or microwave hardware.

You will design and develop mechanical solutions for antenna systems and associated RF and electronic assemblies. The work includes antenna supports and mounts, RF-aware enclosures, radomes, fixed and, where applicable, deployable antenna mechanisms, test fixtures, thermal solutions, connector integration, cable routing, sealing, environmental protection, and platform interfaces. Many of these structures can directly affect antenna and RF performance, requiring close co-design with antenna and RF engineers.

The role covers mechanical architecture, material and manufacturing-process selection, structural and thermal analysis, tolerance definition, detailed CAD design, prototyping, assembly, environmental validation, serviceability, and production release. Particular attention will be given to mechanical structures that directly affect antenna performance, integration, alignment, stability, and deployment.

You will work closely with antenna systems engineers, RF and microwave hardware engineers, system architects, RF test and characterization engineers, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams. The role requires strong mechanical design expertise, RF-aware product thinking, end-to-end technical ownership, and hands-on implementation experience, taking designs from concept through prototype build and qualification to documented, manufacturable antenna assemblies and integrated systems.

Key responsibilities

• Translate system, antenna, and platform requirements into mechanical architectures, interface definitions, design constraints, and technical trade-offs.

• Design mechanical components and assemblies for antenna systems, including supports, mounts, frames, radomes, RF-aware enclosures, fixed or deployable mechanisms, and platform-integration structures.

• Own the detailed mechanical implementation of antenna and RF assemblies, including 3D CAD models, 2D manufacturing drawings, GD&T, assembly-level tolerance analysis, BOMs, and configuration-controlled documentation.

• Develop mechanical solutions that maintain antenna alignment, dimensional stability, RF clearances, grounding, shielding, cable routing, connector accessibility, and other mechanical conditions required to achieve the intended electromagnetic performance.

• Integrate RF modules, antennas, electronics, connectors, cables, gaskets, thermal interfaces, and environmental sealing into complete mechanical assemblies.

• Perform structural, thermal, and tolerance analyses covering stiffness, strength, mass properties, thermal expansion, heat transfer, vibration, shock, and expected environmental loads.

• Define mechanical requirements and work jointly with antenna and RF engineers to establish electromagnetic constraints for radomes, covers, supports, enclosures, and other structures located within or near the antenna field.

• Design antenna deployment and positioning mechanisms, where applicable, including hinges, latches, restraints, stops, alignment features, and associated interfaces.

• Design test fixtures, alignment tools, handling aids, assembly tooling, and prototype-support hardware for antenna and RF system development.

• Select materials, coatings, surface treatments, fasteners, adhesives, seals, bearings, and manufacturing processes based on structural, thermal, RF, environmental, corrosion, and production requirements.

• Lead mechanical prototype build, assembly, troubleshooting, design verification, and iterative improvement.

• Contribute to environmental testing and qualification, including vibration, shock, thermal cycling, ingress protection, and other relevant mechanical validation activities.

• Apply design-for-manufacture, design-for-assembly, serviceability, reliability, and cost considerations throughout development.

• Work with suppliers and manufacturing partners on technical clarification, process selection, prototype production, inspection, non-conformance resolution, and production release.

• Prepare mechanical specifications, analysis reports, interface-control documentation, design-review materials, assembly instructions, and production handover documentation.

• Collaborate with antenna, RF and microwave hardware, system, test, electronics, manufacturing, and partner engineering teams.

• Help establish mechanical design standards, CAD practices, documentation templates, and engineering workflows for the Copenhagen design site.

Required qualifications and experience

• Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• 5+ years of professional mechanical design experience, including demonstrated experience developing mechanical hardware for antenna, RF, or microwave systems where mechanical geometry, materials, interfaces, tolerances, or nearby structures directly influence electromagnetic performance.

• Strong hands-on experience and demonstrated technical ownership of complex mechanical assemblies from initial architecture and concept through detailed design, prototype build, verification, qualification, and production release.

• Advanced proficiency with a professional 3D CAD and drafting environment; SolidWorks experience is preferred.

**Job Description

**Are you a self-starting transformation driver, strategic thinker and pragmatic deliverer, who turns a long-term vision and complex objectives into step-by-step reality and a clear path forward? Do you possess strong project management skills with the ability to translate a multi-year roadmap into smaller bricks and actionable wins, keeping momentum high as requirements evolve? Are you a gifted communicator who breaks down silos and unites cross-functional teams around a lean way of working? Do you possess the business acumen and analytical skills to spot risks and interdependencies across projects and complex organizations? **If so, join us as S&OP Project Manager!

****What The Job Is …

**We have embarked on a multi-year, enterprise-wide transformation program through 2030 to support the long-term growth and industrialization of Satair and Airbus Material Services. We are redesigning the Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD) across various domains and organizations, for a lean operating model powered by a Fit-to-Standard modern ERP and harmonized processes.

One of the key cornerstones of this transformation is the deployment of an integrated end-to-end Sales and Operations Planning process across various businesses.

In your position as S&OP Project Manager you will be part of a cross-functional and cross-organizational project team. In addition to designing and implementing the TO BE S&OP Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD), you will act as the key point between our external consultancy partners, internal business stakeholders and the broader enterprise transformation program.

_Travel required: 15%

_**How You Will Contribute To The Team

**

• PMTD and Architecture Design and Implementation: Design the target Process, Method, Tools and Data covering customer demand, supply capacity and feedback loop mechanisms, including scenario-planning and escalation protocols across and between businesses. Partner with IT and Digital to define the future ERP requirements for S&OP, ensuring a seamless and integrated architecture between Processes and Tools.

• Project Management: Define project roadmap, translate long-term ambition into short-term milestones, maintain project governance, ensure progress towards deliverables, identify and proactively manage interdependencies and risks.

• Stakeholder Alignment Beyond Silos: Proactively identify and engage senior stakeholders across functions and organizations in a complex environment to drive alignment on future ways of working, overcome organizational friction and secure global process simplification and standardization.

• Consultant Management: Lead the relationship with external consultants, steering their deliverables to shape our target S&OP Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD). Validate consultant proposals and recommendations against business needs and context, ensuring designs are scalable and implementable across various business units.

• Strategic Escalations & Executive Briefings: Prepare executive-ready decks, high-impact decision dossiers, trade-off analysis, recommendations and progress updates for executive forums and the central Transformation steering.

• ERP Fit-to-Standard (F2S): Drive business readiness and stakeholder participation across multi-functional teams for F2S workshops to design the future ERP requirements. Safeguard S&OP scope requirements within the central ERP system, ensuring seamless alignment between S&OP process and the future ERP capabilities.

**

• Education: MSc/MA in Business, Economics, Strategy, Finance, Supply Chain or a related field

• Methodologies: Mastery of structured project management and business process mapping.
